remarks: Enjoy a rare opportunity to rent in Kensett Darien where you will enjoy a lavish lifestyle! One of the newer Kensett homes offering 3 sun-filled BRs, 3.5BTHs w/ over 3500 square feet. This home is a corner unit nicely situated in the rear of the association! Beautifully appointed with high end touches offering an open floor plan that includes an elevator for added convenience! Hi-efficiency zoned gas heating and central air.  The living room & den each has a gas fireplace. Gorgeous wood floors throughout main 2 levels. Custom window treatments and high ceilings throughout. Large finished lower level w/recessed lighting perfect for family room + extra unfinished storage + full bath. A kitchen for those who appreciate the 'art of cooking' on a 6 burner Wolf stainless steel gas stove. Attached 2 car garage. Great amenities include the clubhouse w/pool, hot tub + the excellent workout equipment! A walkers' and joggers' paradise on 16 acres. EZ for commuters to Talmadge RR or Springdale RR, Merritt Parkway and I-95! You will find the good life at Kensett Darien right here!
